trustRules: Target placeholder counts and draft labels are visual structure only and never runtime facts.
A source count is shown only from explicit sourceRefs after a non-fallback response; otherwise the fixed cell displays --.

The workbench requests compact gear mode, so slotReadiness and readiness counts are catalog aggregates rather than current editable gear truth. The route may report verified catalog availability, but it must show the current gear draft as 待校验 and route the user to gear_detail for backend resolution; selectedCount, simcReadyCount, requiredReadyCount and candidateCount never upgrade workbench or SimC readiness.
Talent description or formula gaps remain visible as evidence gaps but do not override talentReadiness.simcReady when deciding encoding readiness.
SimC may be marked ready only when talent encoding is SimC-ready and gear fullReady has no missing core slots.
Authenticated remote template failure does not fail the core workbench; local templates remain separately labeled and never appear remote-verified.
The assistant receives only the selected specialization, scenario and current blocker/evidence summary; it cannot invent DPS, ranking, BiS, officiality or player identity.
